children.description: The list to collapse: a `Nav`, a `NavbarNav` or a `TabList`.
children.name: children

className.description: A string of all className you want applied to the component.
className.name: className

collapseBelow.description:
Moves every item into the menu while the component is narrower than this: a width in pixels,
or the name of a breakpoint, read from `--cx-breakpoint-{name}`.
collapseBelow.name: collapseBelow

component.description: Component used for the root node. Either a string to use an HTML element or a component.
component.name: component

iconPlacement.description: Which side of the toggle's text its icon is on.
iconPlacement.name: iconPlacement

menuContainer.description:
Renders the menu in a container element instead of inside the toggle's item, where an
ancestor with `overflow` set would clip it: an element, or `true` for `document.body`. The
menu of a `TabList` is always rendered outside it.
menuContainer.name: menuContainer

menuPlacement.description: Where the menu opens, relative to the toggle. It flips to stay in view.
menuPlacement.name: menuPlacement

moreIcon.description:
The toggle's icon: an icon name, or an element of your own icon set. Defaults to
`IconProvider`'s `more` icon.
moreIcon.name: moreIcon

moreLabel.description: The accessible name of a toggle without text (`moreText={false}`).
moreLabel.name: moreLabel

moreText.description: The toggle's text. `false` leaves the icon alone, named by `moreLabel`.
moreText.name: moreText

onOverflow.description:
Callback fired when items move into the menu or back out of it, with the number of items in
the menu and in the list.
onOverflow.name: onOverflow

threshold.description: The fewest items to leave in the list. They stay even when they don't fit.
threshold.name: threshold

asChild.description:
Render the single child element in place of this component's own element, with this
component's classes, props and ref merged onto it: `<Button asChild><Link href="/login">Log
in</Link></Button>`. The alternative to `component` for React Server Components — an element
can be passed from the server to this package's client components, a component reference
(`component={Link}`) can't.
asChild.name: asChild
